caption: The drawing features two objects placed against a plain, light beige background. On the left side, there is a metallic funnel-shaped container with a handle attached near its top. The container is tilting diagonally to the right, and its surface appears to be a weathered, brownish-gray metal with visible variations in color and texture indicative of wear and age. On the right side, there is a mallet made of brown wood, standing upright. Its cylindrical head is attached to a thick, slightly tapered handle, and the surfaces of the mallet are marked with grains, knots, and slight imperfections characteristic of wood. Both objects are rendered with attention to their material qualities and are positioned so that they are not touching. The artist's signature, "Albert Reidl," appears in small script near the bottom right corner.
title: Sausage Stuffer and Funnel
